fato_historico: 2012: An earthquake off the Pacific coast of Guatemala kills at least 52 people.
energia_do_dia: The day invites you to embrace resilience. Much like the earth settling after a great tremor, your spirit may seek stability amidst change. It is a good time to focus on grounding your emotions and nurturing your connections. Consider how even the smallest shifts in perspective can bring immense peace and renewed strength to your beautiful, balanced soul today.
frase_do_dia: Strength is found in the gentle way we rebuild our inner peace each day.
significado_numero: Represents the collective strength found within communities and shared human journeys.
conselho: Nurture your closest relationships and listen deeply to the needs of those around you.
